title: Other dream locations
content: Does have locations that they visit repeatedly other than the mall? Mine are: A huge school with secret passages that you can crawl through that lead to a huge factory. The factory appears to be melting metal of some kind and there is also a large body of water. There are more crawl through secret passageways here. An underground building with multiple floors. There is a huge center elevator with clear doors that disappears in the top of the building. It’s so high that you cannot see the top floors. This one is the strangest and the dream I have the most often: an Arctic research facility with pods that are connected by cylindrical tunnels that are floating in the ocean.
